define "AggregateTests.FactorialOfFive":
  ({ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }) Num aggregate Result starting 1: Result * Num

define "AggregateTests.AggregateSumWithStart":
  ({ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }) Num
  				  aggregate Result starting 1: Result + Num

define "AggregateTests.AggregateSumWithNull":
  ({ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }) Num
  				  aggregate Result: Coalesce(Result, 0) + Num

define "AggregateTests.AggregateSumAll":
  ({ 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5 }) Num
  				  aggregate all Result: Coalesce(Result, 0) + Num

define "AggregateTests.AggregateSumDistinct":
  ({ 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5 }) Num
  				  aggregate distinct Result: Coalesce(Result, 0) + Num

define "AggregateTests.Multi":
  from ({1}) X, ({2}) Y, ({3}) Z
  				  aggregate Agg: Coalesce(Agg, 0) + X + Y + Z

define "AggregateTests.MegaMulti":
  from ({1, 2}) X, ({1, 2}) Y, ({1, 2}) Z
  				  aggregate Agg starting 0: Agg + X + Y + Z

define "AggregateTests.MegaMultiDistinct":
  from ({1, 2, 2, 1}) X, ({1, 2, 1, 2}) Y, ({2, 1, 2, 1}) Z
  				  aggregate distinct Agg starting 1: Agg + X + Y + Z
